# ELITEA-1544: JR19 - Get Field with Image Descriptions (Happy Path)

**Module:** Jira · **Priority:** Medium · **Type:** Functional

**Objective:** Verify get_field_with_image_descriptions retrieves a JIRA issue field that contains images, returning text with image descriptions generated by the vision model.

## Preconditions

JIRA toolkit is configured and authenticated
JIRA_TOOLKIT_NAME env var is set
JIRA_ISSUE_KEY env var set to an issue whose target field contains embedded images
Vision-capable model configured

## Test Data

JIRA_TOOLKIT_NAME: name of configured JIRA toolkit
JIRA_ISSUE_KEY: key of issue whose description field contains embedded images
Field name: description
Vision model: configured and accessible

## Steps

| # | Action | Expected Result |
|---|--------|----------------|
| 1 | Configure the JIRA toolkit using JIRA_TOOLKIT_NAME env var and valid credentials and a vision-capable model | Toolkit initializes and connects without error |
| 2 | Invoke `get_field_with_image_descriptions` with JIRA_ISSUE_KEY and a field name that contains embedded images (e.g., 'description') | Tool accepts the parameters and begins execution |
| 3 | Capture the tool response | Response contains field text with AI-generated image descriptions inline |
| 4 | Validate that the LLM confirms image descriptions were included in the response | LLM confirms image description text present in field content |

## Expected Final State

LLM confirms image description text present in field content

## Pass/Fail Criteria

get_field_with_image_descriptions returns field content without error
Image descriptions included in response text
No exception raised
